recentItems.title: Old Dominion Football Coach's Show with Ricky Rahne: Episode 2
recentItems.description: After winning its season opener, Old Dominion hits the road for the first time in 2026 to face Virginia Tech.  The Monarchs knocked off the Hokies in Blacksburg last year, picking up their first ever road victory against a power conference foe.   For the first time, Ricky Rahne will go up against his friend and former colleague James Franklin.
